## Harness routing

Canonical policy: `instructions/global.md` §Clarification Gate → **Depth routing**.

| Trigger | Route |
| ------- | ----- |
| User-pivotal scope, approach, success criteria, or architecture fork | `/grill-me` |
| Mid-wave `subtask-pivotal` fork or `blocked-user-pivotal` handoff | Scoped `/grill-me` (one branch; do not re-grill settled areas) |
| Independent enum with clear trade-offs | Batched MCQ (Clarification Gate) |
| Answer in repo, config, or conventions | Explore codebase first |
| Factual/evidence question | `/research` Plan Gate |
